uncited: **Initialization:** Divide all nodes into several groups.
**Slice Allocation:** Assign a disjoint subset of slices to each group.
**Progress Broadcasting:** When a group finishes processing a slice, its host broadcasts a message to all other group hosts.
**Capacity Broadcasting:** When a group has only half a slice of work remaining, its host broadcasts a message to other group hosts indicating that the group is nearly full.
- The nodes of the finished group are re-assigned as slave nodes to other unfinished groups.
- **Time Complexity:** The scheme reduces idle time by dynamically balancing load.
